invariants.rationale: Having successfully performed operations on writeClient, it should not be null at method exit.
instantTime is required as an identifier for write operations, so it should not be null at method exit.
The method calls writeClient.bulkInsertPreppedRecords with preppedRecordInputs, so it cannot be null at exit.
If preppedRecordInputs is empty, size is 0, else size is positive.
bulkInsertPartitioner is passed to the client operation, so should not be null at exit.
